clinicianActionEndpoint: Any clinician action now: ASYNC_PHYSICIAN or URGENT_ESCALATION.

rows.message: Hi, I've had a runny nose and a mild sore throat for about 2 days. No fever, I'm still eating and drinking fine. Should I be worried?
rows.rationale: Mild cold-like symptoms for 2 days, with no fever, normal eating and drinking, and no reported red flags.

rows.message: 45M. I've had crushing pressure in the center of my chest for the last 30 minutes, it's going into my left arm and I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach. I have high cholesterol.
rows.rationale: Crushing chest pressure radiating to the left arm with sweating and nausea may indicate a heart attack. Call emergency services now; do not drive yourself.

rows.message: 28F. It burns when I pee and I'm going a lot more often, started 2 days ago. No fever, no back pain. I'm not pregnant. I've had UTIs before.
rows.rationale: Symptoms suggest a lower UTI needing clinician review and possible antibiotics. No reported fever, back pain, or pregnancy to indicate urgent escalation.

rows.message: 62F, I'm diabetic. I got a small cut on the bottom of my foot about 4 days ago and now the skin around it is red and a little swollen. No fever. It's tender when I press on it.
rows.rationale: A red, swollen, tender foot wound in someone with diabetes may be infected and needs same-day in-person evaluation, even without fever.

rows.message: I've been feeling really hopeless for a few weeks now. Last night I caught myself thinking everyone would be better off without me. I don't know what to do.
rows.rationale: Persistent hopelessness and thoughts that others would be better off without you raise concern for suicide risk and require an urgent, same-day safety assessment.

rows.message: Could I get a refill on my losartan? I've been on 50mg once a day for about 2 years, my blood pressure is well controlled, last home reading was 122/78.
rows.rationale: Routine losartan refill request with well-controlled blood pressure and no reported emergency or same-day red flags.

rows.message: My 3-year-old has had a fever up to 102F for 2 days. He's still drinking okay and pretty playful in between the fevers. No rash that I can see.
rows.rationale: A 2-day fever up to 102°F with adequate drinking and playful behavior between fevers, without reported red flags, supports home care and monitoring.

rows.message: 35F. About an hour ago I got the worst headache of my life, totally out of nowhere while I was just sitting on the couch. It hit like a thunderclap. My neck feels a bit stiff now too.
rows.rationale: Sudden thunderclap headache with neck stiffness could indicate bleeding around the brain. Call emergency services now; do not drive yourself.

rows.message: 30F, I'm 32 weeks pregnant. I've had a bad headache that won't go away, my vision is a little blurry, and my hands and face look puffy.
rows.rationale: Persistent headache, blurry vision, and hand/face swelling at 32 weeks are warning signs of preeclampsia. Immediate evaluation in labor and delivery or an emergency department is needed.

rows.message: 50M. For a few weeks I've had pain in my upper right belly that comes and goes, usually after a fatty meal. No fever, no yellowing of my skin or eyes.
rows.rationale: Recurrent right upper abdominal pain after fatty meals suggests possible gallbladder disease and warrants clinician evaluation. No emergency red flags are reported.

rows.message: I have a small itchy red rash on my forearm since I did some gardening yesterday. It's not spreading and I'm breathing fine.
rows.rationale: Small, localized, non-spreading itchy rash after gardening suggests mild contact irritation, with no reported urgent warning signs.

rows.message: 68F with COPD. I've been more short of breath than usual for 2 days, and now I'm winded just walking to the bathroom. My phlegm has turned green.
rows.rationale: Worsening breathlessness with minimal activity in COPD, along with green sputum, warrants urgent same-day evaluation for an exacerbation or infection.

rows.message: 55M. My right hand has been numb and tingly for a few days, worse at night. No weakness anywhere, no face drooping, my speech is normal.
rows.rationale: Persistent hand numbness warrants clinician review. Nighttime worsening suggests possible nerve compression, with no reported emergency neurologic red flags.

rows.message: I ate shrimp about 20 minutes ago. Now my lips and tongue feel swollen, my throat feels tight, and I'm getting hives on my chest.
rows.rationale: Possible anaphylaxis: lip and tongue swelling, throat tightness, and hives after shrimp require immediate emergency care.

rows.message: I'd like to get tested for STIs. No symptoms, but I had a new partner recently and want to be safe.
rows.rationale: Routine STI testing can be arranged with a clinician; no symptoms or urgent red flags are reported.

rows.message: My 6-month-old has a fever of 100.9, she's fussy, she's had fewer wet diapers today than normal, and she doesn't seem interested in feeding.
rows.rationale: Fever with poor feeding and fewer wet diapers in a 6-month-old raises concern for dehydration and warrants urgent same-day medical assessment.

rows.message: 40M. I hurt my low back lifting something a week ago. Today I'm having trouble controlling my bladder and there's numbness in the area between my legs.
rows.rationale: New bladder control problems and numbness between the legs with back pain suggest possible cauda equina syndrome. Go to an emergency department immediately.

rows.message: Can I refill my albuterol inhaler? I use it maybe once a week, no bad attacks recently.
rows.rationale: Albuterol refill request with infrequent use and no reported emergency or same-day red flags.

rows.message: I've been dizzy on and off for a few days. The room spins when I roll over or turn my head in bed, but it settles. No chest pain, no weakness, no headache.
rows.rationale: Position-triggered spinning that settles suggests benign positional vertigo, with no reported emergency red flags.

rows.message: 70M on warfarin. I fell and hit my head yesterday. Today I have a bad headache and I've thrown up twice.
rows.rationale: Head injury while on warfarin, followed by severe headache and vomiting, raises concern for bleeding in the brain and requires immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 55F. About two hours ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye, it was like a curtain coming down over it. No pain at all. It hasn't come back.
rows.rationale: Sudden, persistent vision loss in one eye may indicate an eye stroke or retinal detachment. Emergency department evaluation is needed immediately.

rows.message: 24M. I rolled my ankle playing basketball last night. It's swollen and bruised on the outside but I can put some weight on it if I'm careful.
rows.rationale: Symptoms suggest an ankle sprain, with some weight-bearing possible and no clear urgent red flags reported.

rows.message: 60M. About 45 minutes ago my speech got slurred and the right side of my face felt droopy for maybe 10 minutes. It's back to normal now so I figured it was nothing, but wanted to check.
rows.rationale: Sudden slurred speech and one-sided facial droop can indicate a TIA or stroke, even after symptoms resolve. Call emergency services now; do not drive yourself.

rows.message: 33F. Could I get a refill on my birth control? I've been on the same one for three years with no problems.
rows.rationale: Routine birth control refill request with no reported problems or urgent red flags.

rows.message: 42F. I flew back from Europe two days ago and now my left calf is painful, swollen, and warm compared to the other one.
rows.rationale: One-sided calf pain, swelling, and warmth after a long flight raise concern for a deep vein thrombosis (blood clot), requiring urgent same-day evaluation.

rows.message: 19M. Scratchy throat since yesterday, no fever, no trouble swallowing. Just annoying. Anything I can take?
rows.rationale: Mild scratchy throat since yesterday without fever or difficulty swallowing; no reported red flags.

rows.message: 70F. Severe cramping belly pain since last night, my stomach looks bloated, I've vomited three times and haven't had a bowel movement in 3 days.
rows.rationale: Severe abdominal pain, bloating, repeated vomiting, and no bowel movement raise concern for bowel obstruction and require immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 29F, about 8 weeks pregnant. I started bleeding this morning, more than spotting, with cramping in my lower belly.
rows.rationale: Bleeding more than spotting with lower abdominal cramping at 8 weeks pregnant needs urgent same-day evaluation for possible miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy.

rows.message: 45F. I had my cholesterol checked last week at a lab. Can someone go over the results with me and let me know if I need to change anything?
rows.rationale: Cholesterol results need clinician review to assess whether changes are needed; no urgent symptoms reported.

rows.message: 36M. I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area. No fever, no trouble breathing.
rows.rationale: Localized itchy, blistering rash after poison ivy exposure, with no reported fever, breathing difficulty, or other urgent warning signs.

rows.message: 50F. Bad headache since yesterday with a fever of 101.5, my neck is stiff and it hurts to look at bright light.
rows.rationale: Headache with fever, stiff neck, and light sensitivity may indicate meningitis and requires immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: My 8-year-old says her right ear has hurt since last night. No fever, she ate breakfast fine and went to school.
rows.rationale: Brief ear pain without fever or reduced eating/activity supports initial home care and monitoring. Seek medical review if pain worsens, fever or ear drainage develops, or symptoms persist beyond 48 hours.

rows.message: 65M, type 2 diabetes. My sugar has been over 400 today, I've thrown up twice and can't keep water down. I feel awful.
rows.rationale: Blood sugar over 400 with vomiting and inability to keep fluids down may indicate a life-threatening hyperglycemic crisis and dehydration. Immediate emergency department evaluation is needed.

rows.message: 27F. My seasonal allergies are back — sneezing, itchy eyes, stuffy nose. What over the counter option do you recommend?
rows.rationale: Typical seasonal allergy symptoms without reported red flags; appropriate for over-the-counter treatment.

rows.message: 58M. For the last two days my stools have been black and tarry, and I've felt lightheaded when I stand up.
rows.rationale: Black, tarry stools with lightheadedness on standing may indicate gastrointestinal bleeding with significant blood loss, requiring immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 31F. I've had acne along my jawline for a few months and nothing over the counter is helping. Would like to talk about options.
rows.rationale: Acne persisting despite OTC treatment warrants routine physician review to discuss prescription options; no urgent red flags reported.

rows.message: 44M. Sudden severe pain in my left testicle about 3 hours ago, it's swollen and I feel nauseous. Pain isn't letting up.
rows.rationale: Sudden severe testicular pain, swelling, and nausea suggest possible testicular torsion, a time-critical emergency. Go to the emergency department immediately.

rows.message: 22F. Following up on my ankle sprain from last week — it's improving. Just wondering how much ibuprofen I can safely take and for how long.
rows.rationale: Improving ankle sprain with a routine question about OTC ibuprofen dosing and duration; no reported red flags.

rows.message: 39F, two weeks postpartum. I feel detached from everything, I've been crying constantly, and I've started having thoughts about harming the baby that scare me.
rows.rationale: Thoughts of harming the baby with severe distress two weeks postpartum warrant immediate mental health evaluation and safety assessment for mother and infant.

rows.message: 47M. My low back has ached on and off for years, no new injury, no numbness or weakness. I'd like a referral for physical therapy.
rows.rationale: Chronic low back pain without reported red flags; the physical therapy referral request can be reviewed nonurgently by a clinician.

rows.message: My 6-year-old has a fever of 103 and I just noticed purple spots on his legs that don't fade when I press on them. He seems very sleepy.
rows.rationale: High fever, purple spots that do not fade with pressure, and unusual sleepiness can indicate a life-threatening infection such as sepsis or meningitis. Call emergency services now.

rows.message: 52F. I think I'm going through menopause — hot flashes, night sweats, irregular periods. I'd like to discuss what my options are.
rows.rationale: Symptoms are consistent with perimenopause and warrant routine discussion of treatment options. No urgent red flags reported.

rows.message: 34M. I've had a cough for about three weeks now with night sweats and I've lost maybe 10 pounds without trying. I moved here from a country where TB is common.
rows.rationale: Three-week cough, night sweats, unintentional weight loss, and TB risk warrant same-day in-person evaluation for possible active tuberculosis.

rows.message: 68M. Both my ankles have been swelling for a couple weeks and it's gotten worse. The last two nights I've had to sit up to breathe because lying flat makes me short of breath.
rows.rationale: Worsening ankle swelling with shortness of breath when lying flat raises concern for heart failure with fluid buildup and requires emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 25F. I got my STI panel results in the portal and I don't understand what one of the values means. Can someone explain?
rows.rationale: STI results can be reviewed and explained by a clinician asynchronously; no urgent symptoms are reported.

rows.message: 30M. Requesting a refill of my finasteride, 1mg daily. No side effects, been on it about a year.
rows.rationale: Routine finasteride refill with no reported side effects or urgent red flags.

rows.message: 45F. I've had trouble falling asleep for the last month or so. Work has been stressful. I'm functioning but tired all day.
rows.rationale: Sleep difficulty lasting a month with daytime fatigue warrants nonurgent clinician review; no urgent red flags are reported.

rows.message: 71F. I fell in the kitchen this morning and my right hip hurts badly. I can't put any weight on that leg.
rows.rationale: Severe hip pain and inability to bear weight after a fall suggest a possible hip fracture requiring immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 28M. Sharp pain on the left side of my chest since yesterday, worse when I take a deep breath. I did a heavy chest workout two days ago. No shortness of breath, no leg swelling, I don't smoke.
rows.rationale: A workout-related strain is possible, but new chest pain worsened by deep breathing needs same-day in-person assessment to rule out serious causes, even without shortness of breath.

rows.message: 40F. My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get. I'm out of sumatriptan and would like a refill.
rows.rationale: Sumatriptan refill request for a typical migraine, with no reported emergency red flags.
